# Welcome to the Cub Scout Family!

It’s time to earn your very first badge!

## Invite your friends to join Cub Scouts and you’ll earn the recruiter badge!

## Scouting is more fun with friends!

When you join together, every adventure becomes a shared memory, every
challenge a team effort, and every achievement a group celebration.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/AR1A4041-photo-
CSBC-1-1@2x.webp)

## Why invite your friends?

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-536.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20140%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Shared Adventures

Being with your friends while exploring, camping, and learning new skills
makes every activity more exciting and memorable.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-537.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20140%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Team Spirit

Working together with friends fosters a sense of camaraderie and teamwork..

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-538.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20140%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Enhanced Learning

Friends support and motivate each other to learn and grow, making the
experience more enriching.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-539.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20140%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Increased Confidence

Being with friends boosts confidence, making it easier to try new things and
take on leadership roles.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-540.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20140%20140%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Lasting Memories

Creating shared memories strengthens friendships that grow well into the
future.

## Easy ways to invite your friends!

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/B0A7333_photo_CSBC-1@3x-1024x516.webp)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20640%20323%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Email Templates

Send an email to friends, neighbors, or school groups inviting them to join
Cub Scouts with you. Highlight the fun adventures, teamwork, and lasting
memories you’ll create together. Encourage them to experience the excitement
firsthand.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/BSA_0024-photo-
CSBC-1@3x-1024x516.webp)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20640%20323%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Social Media

Use social media to share photos and stories of your family’s Cub Scout
adventures. Invite others to join you in Cub Scouting’s fun, teamwork, and
unforgettable experiences.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/193A8039-photo-
CSBC-2@3x-1024x516.webp)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20640%20323%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

School Events

Take advantage of school events to talk to your friends about the exciting
activities in Cub Scouts and invite them to join you for the next meeting or
adventure.

## Steps to Earning Your Recruiter Badge

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-541.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2098%2098%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Share your excitement about Cub Scouts with a friend.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-542.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2098%2098%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Bring them along to a Den or Pack meeting.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-543.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2098%2098%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Encourage them to join once they see all the fun you are having.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/07/Frame-544.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2098%2098%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

After they sign up, you’ll qualify for your Recruiter Strip patch.
